name: Industrious Labs
summary: Campaigns to cut emissions from heavy industry (steel, aluminium, cement, industrial heat, landfills) in the US, through rules, company pressure and community organising; its 501(c)(3) is Industrious Education Fund.

spending.source: https://projects.propublica.org/nonprofits/organizations/510198509 (estimated: Tides Foundation's 2024 grants to Climate Strategies Lab LLC, Industrious Labs' operating company, $3,123,870 (Form 990 Schedule I), over the 75% of its spending we judge they paid, plus $38,667 spent by its 501(c)(3) Industrious Education Fund, https://projects.propublica.org/nonprofits/organizations/992396851; the company publishes no accounts)
